rationale: The candidate reads as a compact mass but not as a coherent neighborhood-living building. Across views it is mostly a boxy stacked/cantilevered object with inconsistent section logic and little convincing public ground response. The verified access edge is not clearly opened with a court, notch, seam, or undercut; instead the form stays largely sealed and semantically indifferent to frontage. The stepped and clipped facets create some visual activity, but not a strong one-rule massing system, and the silhouette does not establish a believable terrace/public-void relationship. Repair integrity is acceptable because the solid remains continuous and not obviously self-colliding, but the program contract needs a cleaner dominant gesture and a more explicit accessible void aligned to the access edge.
